opening: A storm gathers over the harbour. Through the rain, the old lighthouse blinks twice and falls dark. Your guide waits beside the harbour gate. What do you do?
instructions: Let the player decide their actions. Keep the mystery grounded in the harbour and lighthouse. The keeper is helpful, but worried about the storm.

scenes.title: Harbour
scenes.description: Fishing boats strain against their ropes in the gathering storm.

scenes.title: Lighthouse
scenes.description: A locked door and a rusted keypad stand beneath the dark tower.

arguments.text: You reach the lighthouse. Rain runs over a small keypad beside the door. A light moves behind the frosted glass.

entries.title: The keeper
entries.text: The lighthouse keeper is Mira. She knows the harbour and wants to protect its boats.

entries.title: Storm
entries.text: A severe storm is approaching the harbour. The lighthouse has gone dark.
